history.content: i dont even know why im here honestly
There is a kind of unmoored feeling in “i dont even know why im here honestly.” If you want, you can just say what today has been like.
idk it was just a normal day i guess. annoying. people are annoying
That sounds less like a big emotion and more like irritation rubbing against an otherwise ordinary day. Is it the people part that feels sharpest, or the whole day had that edge?
one person. idk. its stupid its not even a big deal
Not stupid, just small and sharp. Did it feel more like being irritated, or more like being put off by that one person?
my friend. shes supposed to be my best friend. i had this thing on friday id been stressing about for weeks and she just. didnt come. and didnt even text till the next day like it was nothing
That landed as a breach of something important, not just a small annoyance. I’m learning there’s hurt here too, underneath the anger, and maybe a sense of being left hanging.
im not hurt im pissed. like this is the third time. i always show up for her stuff always. and her excuse was she lost track of time. lost track of time. ok

I had the hurt piece wrong, let me step back. This sounds more like anger that has been building because it feels one-sided, and “lost track of time” didn’t hold much weight for you. Is it more irritation, resentment, or feeling disrespected?
disrespected yeah. like my time doesnt matter to her. and im so tired of being the only one who tries
Yes, that sounds disrespected, and also worn down by being the one who keeps trying. What does it make you want to do, push back, pull away, or say something straight?
idk. probably nothing like always. i dont have the energy for it tonight. but thanks i guess. needed to get that out
You got it out, and that’s enough for tonight. I can leave it there with the anger and the tiredness, if you want.
